artifact.value_head: runs/g7f_E/model.pt @ origin/claude/silver-gen7-act4-data 0168b72d (not exported; used only for value MSE)

data.split: validation fold r_seed % 5 == 3 (silver_az_mlp.Data / arch_dev.py VAL; the fold train.json reports and early-stopping/best-epoch selection used). Test fold 4 not touched.

metric: per-root CE of the softmax prior vs search-visit shares (as train.json val); top-1 = argmax prior == argmax visits (first max); value-head MSE vs won*(53+endHp)/100 (roots with a value). d = permuted - baseline (CE up = worse; top1 down = worse).

scheme.state: one random permutation of all 582,140 validation roots per repeat; root r receives the group's raw columns from root pi[r]; encounter/monster-id/intent embeddings and target-slot features recomputed from the permuted raw state
scheme.candidate: roots permuted within strata of equal candidate count (22 singleton roots stay fixed); edge j of root r gets the group's columns (targeting group: also the target slot) of edge j of the partner root; visit labels stay
scheme.ci: 95% percentile CI, 1,000 cluster-bootstrap resamples over (source, r_seed) clusters of the per-root delta averaged over repeats; window = orig,x5,g3-g6 (gen-6 window, A0), g7a4 = Act-4 A20 roots

groups.group: monster slots m0-m4 (+id/intent embeddings, target features)
cand: targeting (aTargetsEnemy, aTargetHp, target slot -> slot features)
hand (count, nAvail by type, hd* composition)
